conditions.evidence: Document 07 §4 is the requirement and document 05 its screens; where the build differs is in document 15 §8. Not approved as a module.

Tables for leads, contacts, companies, tasks and visits exist and build on MySQL in CI. Who holds the records is not settled: an enquiry from the React shop is still written to the old database, which held 1 lead and 1 client on 17 November.

The module's two addresses for the shop, an enquiry and the WhatsApp hand-off, are in the contract of `/api/v1` (`platform/resources/api/v1.openapi.json`; the rules are document 29) and are held to it key by key on every push (`Feature/Api/V1ContractTest.php`). An enquiry sent twice with its key is written once (`Feature/Api/IdempotencyTest.php`), and two enquiries in the same moment are both written (`Feature/Crm/EnquiryTurnTest.php`, and two processes in CI). Validation, limits and the trap for robots as before (`Feature/PublicLeadApiTest.php`, `Feature/VersionedLeadApiTest.php`). Staff have no API: the screens are Livewire. That the live shop's forms use these addresses is the condition above, not this one (T-100).

No address opens without a sign-in, and one role is checked against every address (`Feature/AdminRouteAccessTest.php`). A sales person cannot open a colleague's lead, and only a manager reassigns one or merges contacts (`Feature/LeadShowTest.php`, `Feature/ContactsTest.php`). The roles are the inherited eight; the owner's matrix and its test are still to come.

Leads: list, board, page, create, edit, reassign, import from a sheet, export. Contacts: list, page, a duplicate refused, merge. Tasks and visits: list, add, book. The lead, its task, the search, the export and the import are also pressed in the browser journey.

An empty list says so and offers the next step; a refusal and an error have their own pages (`Feature/ErrorPagesTest.php`). There is no placeholder while a list loads and no notice when the connection is lost, and the five states are not yet one standard.

Pass in the suite of 17 November (2,484 tests; the same suite on MySQL 8.4 in CI): `Feature/LeadsIndexTest.php`, `Feature/LeadShowTest.php`, `Feature/ContactsTest.php`, `Feature/TasksAndVisitsTest.php`, `Feature/LeadCsvImportTest.php`, `Feature/Crm/LeadCsvExportTest.php`, `Feature/PipelineBoardTest.php`, `Feature/Sales/LeadValueFollowsQuotationTest.php`, `Unit/PhoneTest.php`.

Pressed in a browser: create a lead, reopen it, add a task, find it by search, export, upload a sheet; the owner hands a lead to a sales person and is asked why; the client's yes makes the lead Won and the contact a client. Not pressed: an enquiry arriving through the shop's form (the shop does not write to Laravel yet), booking a visit, merging two contacts.
Planned, not built: the shop's forms write to Laravel, the old records are imported with a trial run and a comparison, and the old way in is closed.

Tables for quotations and their versions, invoices, payments and receipts exist; a document is frozen when it is sent. The old system has its own quotations and invoices — none recorded on 17 November — and one writer is still to be decided.

The basket's address is in the contract of `/api/v1` (`platform/resources/api/v1.openapi.json`; the rules are document 29) and is held to it key by key on every push (`Feature/Api/V1ContractTest.php`, `Feature/StorefrontQuoteRequestApiTest.php`); a basket sent twice with its key is written once. The client's pages for a quotation and an invoice open on signed links (`Feature/QuotePortalTest.php`); they are pages, not an API. Staff have no API: the screens are Livewire.

No address opens without a sign-in, and one role is checked against every address (`Feature/AdminRouteAccessTest.php`). Sending above a role's discount limit needs a manager (`Feature/QuoteSendingTest.php`); only accounts confirm a payment (`Feature/PaymentsTest.php`); a sales person cannot void an invoice (`Feature/Sales/InvoiceScreenTest.php`). The roles are the inherited eight; the owner's matrix and its test are still to come.

Quotations: list, create, builder, approval, send, revise, PDF, the client's page. Invoices: list, page, collect, void. Payments: list, record, confirm, send back. Documents: library and design. Issuing a document is blocked until the owner's terms and signers are confirmed, and Furniture has no template or price list yet.

An empty list says so and offers the next step; a refusal and an error have their own pages (`Feature/ErrorPagesTest.php`). There is no placeholder while a list loads and no notice when the connection is lost, and the five states are not yet one standard.

Pass in the suite of 17 November (2,484 tests; the same suite on MySQL 8.4 in CI): `Feature/QuotesTest.php`, `Feature/QuoteSendingTest.php`, `Feature/QuotationSafetyTest.php`, `Feature/PaymentsTest.php`, `Feature/PaymentIntegrityTest.php`, `Feature/Sales/InvoiceScreenTest.php`, `Feature/Sales/ClientAnswerTest.php`, `Feature/Sales/BillingTimelineTest.php`, `Feature/DocumentLibraryTest.php`, `Unit/QuoteCalculatorTest.php`.

Pressed in a browser on the rehearsal, and in CI on every push that touches the admin (`.github/workflows/vercel-livewire.yml`): a quotation above the discount limit is held, approved by the sales manager, sent, accepted by the client — on a page of their own where those pages are on, written down by staff where they are off — invoiced in full, paid in part against a slip, and receipted as a PDF; also the quotation PDF and the client's statement PDF. Each step is pressed by the role that does it. The same journey on staging with real test records is T-133.
Planned, not built: quotations, invoices and payments of the two systems merged, with Furniture's templates.
